webster.text: To imprison; to confine in a jail.

more.text: To confine; to shut up or inclose.

example.quote: My honorable friend's remarks were right, with respect to incarcerating a state.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
